requirement: Identify cryptographic algorithms and cipher suites in use within security protocols to enable algorithm transitions.
evidence_quote: Security protocols include a mechanism to identify the algorithm or cipher suite in use. An algorithm identifier might be explicitly carried in the protocol, a management mechanism can be used to identify the algorithm, or the algorithm might be implied by the protocol version number.

requirement: Establish local policies to select algorithms and limit allowable combinations during session establishment.
evidence_quote: Local policy can limit the allowable combinations. ... Local policy may select an algorithm other than the mandatory-to-implement one.

requirement: Develop a strategic plan to manage cryptographic risks and integrate crypto agility into the organization's risk management framework.
evidence_quote: Executives can leverage the insights in this paper to develop a comprehensive strategic and tactical plan that integrates crypto agility into the organization’s overall risk management framework...

requirement: Utilize certificate expiration and revocation mechanisms to enforce the transition away from vulnerable algorithms.
evidence_quote: A cryptographic key is associated with a particular algorithm, which means that key expiration and revocation are important tools for cryptographic algorithm transition.

requirement: Configure systems to prohibit the use of specific vulnerable algorithms to force transitions.
evidence_quote: Additionally, administrators can change a configuration setting to prohibit the use of a particular algorithm as a means of forcing algorithm transition.

requirement: Implement mechanisms to determine when deployed implementations have shifted from old algorithms to new ones.
evidence_quote: Implementations should also provide a way to determine when deployed implementations have shifted from the old algorithms to more desirable ones.

requirement: Monitor cryptographic research results to discover new attacks and assess impacts on existing protocols.
evidence_quote: Monitoring cryptographic research results provides a way to discover new attacks, assess impacts to existing security protocols, and foresee needed changes.

requirement: Ensure algorithm negotiation mechanisms include integrity protection to prevent downgrade attacks.
evidence_quote: The mechanism that a security protocol uses to perform cryptographic algorithm negotiation should include integrity protection. If the integrity of algorithm selection during negotiation is not protected, the protocol will be subject to a downgrade attack...

requirement: Ensure employees, partners, and suppliers involved in cryptographic design and deployment consider and adopt crypto agility practices.
evidence_quote: ...ensuring that employees, business partners, and technology suppliers involved in cryptographic design, implementation, acquisition, deployment, and use consider and adopt these practices.

requirement: Establish a systems approach to provide mechanisms enabling transitions to alternative algorithms while limiting vulnerable algorithm use.
evidence_quote: Achieving crypto agility requires a systems approach to providing mechanisms that enable the transition to alternative algorithms and limit the use of vulnerable algorithms in a seamless way...

requirement: Coordinate among stakeholders — protocol designers, implementers, operators, IT and cybersecurity architects, software and standards developers, hardware designers, and executives — to manage crypto agility.
evidence_quote: This paper also discusses crypto agility in different contexts and highlights the coordination needed among stakeholders.

requirement: Implement capabilities to replace and adapt cryptographic algorithms in protocols, applications, and infrastructure without disrupting operations.
evidence_quote: Cryptographic (crypto) agility refers to the capabilities needed to replace and adapt cryptographic algorithms in protocols, applications, software, hardware, firmware, and infrastructures while preserving security and ongoing operations.

requirement: Facilitate migrations between cryptographic algorithms without significant changes to the application using them.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility facilitates migrations between cryptographic algorithms without significant changes to the application that is using the algorithms.

requirement: Adopt new cryptographic algorithms and stop the use of vulnerable algorithms in applications without disrupting the running system.
evidence_quote: In a system, crypto agility is the ability to adopt new cryptographic algorithms and stop the use of vulnerable algorithms in applications without disrupting the running system.

requirement: Maintain interoperability when introducing new cryptographic algorithms and prevent the use of vulnerable algorithms in protocols.
evidence_quote: In a protocol, crypto agility is the ability to maintain interoperability when introducing new cryptographic algorithms and preventing the use of vulnerable algorithms.

requirement: Seamlessly and rapidly transition away from vulnerable cryptographic algorithms and adopt new, stronger ones without significant infrastructure changes.
evidence_quote: In an enterprise, crypto agility is a capacity to seamlessly and rapidly transition away from vulnerable cryptographic algorithms and adopt new, stronger ones without incurring significant changes to their infrastructure or experiencing unnecessary disruptions.

requirement: Recognize that crypto agility practices are unstructured and unplanned as the Tier 1 baseline; gap-close target is a documented strategic plan.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility practices are unstructured and unplanned.

requirement: Detect that each group or team implements its own cryptography on a case-by-case basis; consolidate selection authority to close the Tier 1 gap.
evidence_quote: Each group or team within the organization implements its own cryptography on a case-by-case basis.

requirement: Identify that algorithm and library selection is not informed by current exploits and threat intelligence; subscribe to advisories to advance from Tier 1.
evidence_quote: The selection of cryptographic algorithms, schemes, libraries, and cryptographic products and services is not informed by current cryptographic-based exploits and evolving threat landscapes.

requirement: Acknowledge the organization is unaware of cryptographic risks from partners, suppliers, and acquired products; build a supply-chain visibility program.
evidence_quote: The organization is unaware of potential cryptographic risks from partners, suppliers, and acquired products and services.

requirement: Inventory current cryptography usage and external-partner crypto practices; Tier 1 organizations have limited internal and external awareness.
evidence_quote: Organizational and external awareness (including partners and suppliers) of cryptography usage is limited.

requirement: Establish a formal cryptographic policy and architecture; the absence of these in Tier 1 hinders internal and external communication.
evidence_quote: A formal cryptographic policy or architecture is lacking, hindering internal and external communication.

requirement: Schedule regular crypto-agility discussions across the organization; Tier 1 conversations are infrequent and inconsistent.
evidence_quote: Discussions about the organization's crypto agility are infrequent and inconsistent.

requirement: Formally integrate crypto agility into the organizational risk management plan, guided by a defined cryptographic policy.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility is formally integrated into the organization's risk management plan and is guided by a well-defined cryptographic policy.

requirement: Define, implement, review, and assess cryptographic policies, processes, procedures, roles, and responsibilities on a recurring cadence.
evidence_quote: The cryptographic policy, processes, procedures, roles, and responsibilities are defined, implemented, reviewed, and assessed.

requirement: Regularly update crypto-agility practices and architectures in response to business / mission / threat / technological evolution.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility practices and cryptographic architectures are regularly updated based on changes in business and mission requirements, threats, and technological evolution.

requirement: Include crypto agility in organizational awareness and training curricula so developers and personnel have appropriate skills.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility is part of the organizational awareness and training curriculum to ensure that personnel, particularly developers, have the appropriate knowledge and skills.

requirement: Deploy integrated and automated cryptographic discovery and remediation tools to prioritize and continuously mitigate crypto risks.
evidence_quote: Integrated and automated cryptographic discovery and remediation tools are used to prioritize and continuously mitigate cryptographic risks.

requirement: Continuously test crypto-agility practices to measure organizational impact and verify readiness to activate them when required.
evidence_quote: Crypto-agility practices are continuously tested to measure their impact on organizational processes in support of the mission and to ensure that the organization is adequately prepared to activate them when necessary.

requirement: Treat crypto agility as a fundamental element of organizational risk management with explicit, defined objectives.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility is a fundamental element of organizational risk management with defined objectives.

requirement: Monitor, measure, and report crypto agility to executives as a line item in the risk register linked to financial and mission objectives.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility is monitored, measured, and reported to executives as part of the risk register and linked to financial, business, and mission objectives.

requirement: Consider crypto agility in every executive-level business decision and at every line of code authored by developers.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility is considered in all changes to business objectives at the executive level and in every line of code by developers.

requirement: Continuously adapt, monitor, and communicate crypto agility policies and procedures in near real-time as the environment changes.
evidence_quote: Crypto agility policies, processes, and procedures are continuously adapted, monitored, and communicated in near real-time in response to changes in the environment, such as standards, regulations, supply chains, partners ecosystems, mission and business requirements, and threat and technological landscapes.
